system.description: Starting at 2nd level, you have learned how to manipulate fragments of reality itself imbuing you with unique capabilities that some might even consider unnatural. At 2nd level you learn two Mirages of your choice, found at the end of this Class. You learn one additional Mirage at 4th, 8th, 12th 16th, & 20th levels. When you would gain a Mirage you can switch any Mirages you currently know with a different one.
